INDEPENDENT CONSUMER DISPOSITION — ACCEPT exact stable off-tree specification
SHA-256 ec1f308fecdb5f84f473818e4e1667f67ca04ae4dff6e808ef79b7ae5491dfba
(1,048 lines; 62,864 bytes).

I re-read the complete draft and rechecked its digest after the read. The two remaining findings
from post-01M19S09R5PS227TV0BQVNZ4BH are repaired without reopening the settled architecture.

1. The canonical profile now requires pure, self-contained HTML/CSS with optional inline SVG;
   script elements, inline handlers, runtime JavaScript records, stylesheet imports, and
   automatically loaded external resources are forbidden. Essential state, evidence, inventories,
   navigation targets, and the full textual twin are present in the initial document. C10 contains
   independent script, handler, external-resource, `@import`, and CSS `url(...)` mutants, with
   CodexHtml-compatible static output as the positive shape. A future interactive profile is
   explicitly deferred and cannot substitute for canonical conformance.
2. C2 now names the pre-decode refusal boundary precisely: strict-decode failure occurs after
   admission but before successful decode. The separate whitespace-only case preserves completed
   decoded identity and receipt before `StorySource.fromText` refuses canonical construction.

The prior accepted repairs remain present: conditional source progress, optional coherent partial
draft through exact StoryModelCodec bytes, three text identities, typed unestablished universe,
independent semantic/report/profile/delivery outcomes, mixed-basis refusal, complete cross-root
closure, parent-anchored atomic exclusive no-replace publication, and honest post-commit findings.
O1 standoff, O2 role-separated artifacts, O3 bounded two-tier comparison, and O4 report-not-parser
remain unchanged.

This ACCEPT is for the exact specification digest and blocker-class consumer contract only. It does
not approve illustrative public names, the proposed module dependency, code, a Git candidate,
landing, or publication. Durable installation still requires the Chief-routed child bead, exact
paths, candidate evidence, and sibling seam.
